actual_scope: Classify a sum-only two-product parent on congruent operands, prove the limits of one product with separate encoders, and price explicit ordinary circuits. Compare with the literal Gaussian and mixed-rank callers.
scope_change_reason: A shared carry can replace recursive work only when a parent consumes a sum and the source promises sufficient agreement. This study replaces single-product encoders on odd operands with a sibling dot product and checks a concrete corrected circuit.
bottleneck_link: The frozen signed reference needs positive recursive savings. The package prices a finite ordinary saving and identifies the parent and correlation needed to transfer it.
stop_rule: One hour including delivery, 45 minutes discovery. Stop the recursive construction if the charged caller has no eligible parent or if a proved row obstruction excludes the price.
